title: Taking a cornetist's place and Sam Morgan's start
summary: He recounts replacing a sick trumpeter and says Sam Morgan stepped in, which led to Morgan's band; he claims he was first to cross the lake.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: And so I was there and I played, I took his place. And so Sam Morgan, he was playing in the hall across the river there. He stole the...
Isaiah. Let me see how that thing was.
Let me see how that thing was.
It's always there that I played. I took his place.

And so Sam Morgan, he was playing in the hall across the river there. And Sam Morgan, he stole the Isaiah. Let me see how that thing was. I believe it was Sam. Sam Morgan, Jack Paeda was playing trumpet in the band across there and Sam Morgan, he went over there. He got sick. Jack Paeda got sick. Sam Morgan, he went over there in his place and hid him over his face. So when he got better they find him. And that's why he made the band up, Sam Morgan's band. Yeah, and I was the first one to start him to cross the lake.

I started him to cross the lake. Sometimes I played two trumpet. I carried two trumpet. You know, they helped me out sometimes. Couldn't get no piano. I played two trumpet. Well, the piano said, well, I take two trumpet. Sometimes no trombones. I said, well, I was the first one. And then they got big. Mo Beers, then he was Morgan's band, was a nice band then. I was the first one to cross then. Well, I used to play everywhere. All around Hmong City. All around from to Bonmore. Bonmore. We got off in Lafayette, Bonmore. And the place from Bonmore, they called it to, where the refound rat. Is that up the river? No, it's down on the coast.
